# Typography

Font: **Be Vietnam Pro** (variable `--font-family-ui`, fallback `system-ui, sans-serif`). Weights 400, 500, 600, 700. Local files and the OFL licence are in `prototype/shared/assets/` (`be-vietnam-pro-*.ttf`); the app bundles them in `pema-kmp/core/ui`; the Next.js front end loads the family through `next/font`. Vietnamese needs this font: never fall back to a serif in inputs or headings. Code and raw text use the system monospace (`ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas`) at label size.

## Scale

Source: `tokens.json` `text` (px; dp/sp in the app). Always use the token name (`--text-<name>`), never a pixel value.

| Token | Size | Role | Weight | Line height | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eyebrow` | 10px | Eyebrow | 600, uppercase, +0.1em | 1.4 | Small label above a title, sidebar section titles, hero kicker |
| `micro` | 11px | Micro | 500-700 | 1.3-1.6 | Counters inside chips and tabs, table column heads (uppercase +0.06em), timestamps under a bubble |
| `label` | 12px | Label | 500-600 | 1.4 | Field labels (600, ink-soft), badges (500), sub lines, hints, errors |
| `small` | 13px | Small | 500-600 | 1.5 | Buttons (600), chips (500), notices, dense table text, secondary lines |
| `body` | 14px | Body | 400-600 | 1.5 | Default text, table cells, tab labels, list titles (600) |
| `body-lg` | 15px | Body large | 400-700 | 1.35 | Field values, card titles (700, heading colour), empty-state title (600), h4 heading (600) |
| `section` | 16px | Section | 600-700 | 1.3 | h3 heading, dialog title (600), stat value (700), prescription titles |
| `subtitle` | 20px | Subtitle | 700 | 1.25 | h2 heading, appointment day number, progress label |
| `title` | 25px | Title | 700 | 1.2 | h1 heading in a page body; page title at 390 (replaces page) |
| `metric` | 27px | Metric | 700 | 1.2 | KPI value |
| `page` | 30px | Page | 700 | 1.2 | Page title (`pageHead`) at 1440 and 1920 |

## Headings and titles

| Element | Token | Weight | Colour |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page title (`pageHead`) | `page` 30 (title 25 at 390) | 700 | `heading` |
| `h1` | `title` 25 | 700 | `heading` |
| `h2` | `subtitle` 20 | 700 | `heading` |
| `h3` | `section` 16 | 700 | `heading` |
| `h4` | `body-lg` 15 | 600 | `ink` |
| Card title (`card`) | `body-lg` 15 | 700 | `heading` (tint colour when tinted) |
| Dialog title | `section` 16 | 600 | `ink` |
| KPI value | `metric` 27 (22 at 390) | 700 | `heading` |
| Eyebrow | `eyebrow` 10 | 600, uppercase, +0.1em | `info` |

Note: `design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md` says "h3 = card title 16"; the card block draws its title at 15 (`body-lg`), the `h3` heading at 16. Both are as the canvas CSS draws them.

## Rules

- Body text 14 or 15; label 12; never shrink text to cram content, wrap or use a card instead. Test long Vietnamese names, prices and multi-line notes.
- Weights above 700 (the old web used 750 and 800 in a few places) are not part of the system.
- A money value never wraps before the currency sign: the sample data uses a no-break space before "₫".
- Text colours: `ink` for content, `ink-soft` for metadata (contrast in colors.md), `link` for links and selected tabs, status text only together with the status word.
- Phone (390): page title 25, KPI value 22; on Patient Mobile frames the hero title is 21; everything else keeps its token.
